items.title: Taxi to the Shoushan Trailhead
items.getThere: Taxi to the 龍泉寺 trailhead (route 1 of the seven Chaishan trail routes starts at 龍泉寺登山口). Kaohsiung Travel lists parking at the Chaishan trails.
tips: Eat before leaving and pack food in a closed bag — macaques frequent the trails from the trailhead onward.

items.title: Shoushan / Chaishan Hike
highlights: Seven marked routes on raised-coral limestone; mostly boardwalk, but 盤榕道 (banyan-root route) needs hands and feet among boulders — the fit-hiker option.
Look for 泰國谷, 一線天 and 一簾幽夢 rock/banyan scenery; the popular end-point 雅座亭 looks out over the Taiwan Strait.
Former military land opened from 1989, so native forest is well preserved; wild Formosan macaques and squirrels are common.
tips: Trail signposts give walking times between junctions — use them to time the descent for the late-morning ferry.
Kaohsiung Travel publishes a map of mobile-signal points on the main Shoushan trails; download offline maps.
items.watch: Limestone and roots get slippery in rain; skip 盤榕道 if wet. Keep food sealed and don't feed or approach macaques.

sources.label: Kaohsiung Travel – Shoushan National Nature Park

items.title: Descend to Gushan → Ferry to Cijin
items.hours: Mon Dec 7 = weekday timetable: 09:50–16:10 a boat roughly every 12–15 min (08:30–09:50 and 16:10–20:00 every 8–12 min). Crossing ~5 min.
items.cost: Adult pedestrian NT$30 cash (discounted from NT$40) or NT$30 by iPASS/EasyCard/icash2.0.
items.getThere: Gushan Ferry Station, 高雄市鼓山區濱海二路1號 → Cijin Ferry Station, 旗津區海岸路10號.
highlights: Cijin Ferry Station reopened in July 2026 as the new '光之渡口' (Ferry of Light) building.
tips: Have coins ready — cash fares are paid by dropping coins at boarding (請自備零錢投幣登船); tapping an EasyCard/iPASS is the same NT$30.
Timetable is indicative only: tides, weather and ship traffic in the harbour can shift sailings.
items.watch: Gushan station building is being rebuilt (its phone line is diverted to 07-571-2542); boats run, but confirm the temporary boarding point on arrival.

items.title: Cijin Headland — Lighthouse, Fort, Coastal Paths
items.hours: Kaohsiung Lighthouse: 10:00–21:00 daily, no closing day (Monday closure was dropped). Cihou Fort: open 24 h.
items.getThere: Lighthouse: 高雄市旗津區旗下巷34號, on top of 旗後山 (tel 07-571-5021). The fort sits on the south side of the same hill, facing the lighthouse.
highlights: Lighthouse built 1883 by British engineer John Reginald Harding, rebuilt 1918; Taiwan's only white octagonal brick lighthouse (15.2 m tower, light 58.2 m above sea).
Its wind vane is the only one in Taiwan marked with Chinese characters 東西南北; small exhibition of old lighthouse equipment, sundial on the lawn, café on site.
Cihou Fort: largest and best-preserved of the harbour's three forts; red brick with 囍 and bat motifs and the '威震天南' gate inscription.
From the fort: Port No. 1 breakwaters, Cijin Beach and the city skyline — good for watching big ships enter.

items.title: Optional Hotel Shower Stop
items.getThere: Ferry back to Gushan (weekday boats every ~12–15 min until 16:10, then every 8–12 min), then KRTC Orange Line from O1 哈瑪星 to O5/R10 美麗島, change to the Red Line one stop north to R11 高雄車站.

items.title: Travel North to Zuoying
items.getThere: From R11 高雄車站 the Red Line runs north via R13 凹子底, R14 巨蛋 and R15 生態園區 to R16 左營; a taxi straight to 文慈路76號 avoids an unverified last-mile walk.

items.title: Shrimp Fishing — 佰吉星釣蝦競技場
items.getThere: 高雄市左營區文慈路76號 (same address previously listed for 佰吉興 shrimp hall).
highlights: An Oct 10 2026 food-blogger reel describes it as newly (re)opened as a shrimp-fishing + stir-fry (熱炒) venue with big Thai prawns in many flavours, golden-sand squid, crispy ginger chicken and squid-conch-garlic soup.
tips: Hours and rod prices are still not published by the venue; phone 07-350-3909 (number from the existing plan) the day before.
A July 2026 post on the venue's FB (seen via search snippet) announced an internal renovation and '全新升級 即將登場'; the Oct reel suggests it has reopened.
items.watch: All details here come from social posts, not an official listing — verify opening hours, pricing and whether rods can be shared before committing the evening.

sources.label: Search results for the venue (FB/IG snippets)

items.title: Grill the Catch → Proper Dinner
highlights: Per the Oct 2026 reel, shrimp you catch can be cooked by the kitchen on request (代客料理), and there's a full stir-fry/grill/fried menu — so the 'late meal' can happen in the same venue.
tips: Order a chicken or pork stir-fry alongside the shrimp to round out the protein.
items.watch: Cooking-fee and menu prices not published; ask when ordering.

items.title: Back to the Hotel
items.getThere: Taxi, or Red Line south (toward 小港) from the Zuoying-area stations (R16 左營 / R14 巨蛋 / R13 凹子底) to R11 高雄車站.
